cohort: 295,961 women who gave birth in 2018 in Japan
finding: The incidence of VTE in pregnant women in Japan in 2018 was 0.082%, with deep vein thrombosis being more common than pulmonary thromboembolism, and the incidence of antepartum VTE being higher than postpartum VTE.
mod_finding: The incidence of VTE after cesarean section (0.0074%) was significantly higher than that after vaginal delivery (0.0012%).
